summary: Lists the information that must be provisioned on a customer edge router for several transition methods that carry IPv4 over IPv6 using tunnels. It aims to define reusable components, and to the extent provisioning is dynamic, to carry them in AAA attributes.

eli5.summary: When a home router needs setup details for sending old-style traffic over the new network, this lists them.
